title: Cell – The Fundamental Unit of Life
description: A 20-question multiple-choice quiz on the cell and its organelles.
instructions: The timer starts when you begin the quiz.
Your result will be calculated automatically after submission.

questions.text: Who first observed and named the tiny compartments in a slice of cork as cells?
Which cell organelle is known as the powerhouse of the cell because it releases energy?
Which organelle controls most activities of a eukaryotic cell?
Which organelle contains chlorophyll and is the main site of photosynthesis in green plants?
Which structure forms the selectively permeable boundary around the cell?
Which organelle contains digestive enzymes that break down worn-out cell parts?
Which rigid outer covering gives support and protection to plant cells?
Which cell structure is chiefly responsible for protein synthesis?
What is the jelly-like material inside a cell in which organelles are suspended?
Which unicellular organism can change its shape with the help of pseudopodia?
Which organelle modifies, sorts and packages materials for transport inside or outside the cell?
Which organelle is often called the suicide bag of the cell?
What is the basic structural and functional unit of life?
Which cell component regulates the movement of substances into and out of the cell?
Which type of cell division is responsible for growth and repair in many multicellular organisms?
Which molecule carries hereditary information in most living organisms?
Which cell organelle commonly stores water, nutrients and waste materials?
Which of the following is a prokaryotic organism that lacks a membrane-bound nucleus?
What does chlorophyll mainly help a plant do during photosynthesis?
Which scientists are credited with proposing the cell theory?
